subject: Cross-region demo: scheduling & DST considerations
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Acme Corp Scheduling <scheduling@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Cross-region demo — options for next week

Hi John —

Thanks again for the quick intro. Weʼd love to get a 45-minute product walkthrough with your team next week. I know you mentioned folks on the West Coast and a couple of contributors in Europe, so I put together a few options that try to span both regions.

Options (all shown in local times):
- Tue, Mar 9 — 8:00 AM PT / 11:00 AM ET / 17:00 CET
- Wed, Mar 10 — 8:00 AM PT / 11:00 AM ET / 17:00 CET
- Thu, Mar 11 — 5:30 PM PT / 8:30 PM ET / 02:30 CET (next day) — late slot for EU

Quick note on DST: the US switches to DST on Sun, Mar 8. That will shift the US <-> EU offset by one hour for a few weeks until Europe moves on Mar 29. I called out local times above but if you pick a date after Mar 8 we should re-confirm the CET/CEST mapping — happy to do that for you.

Please let me know which option works for the core stakeholders (dev + infra + security). If none work I can loop in Jonas (solutions engineer, EU) and Sean (team lead) to cover a late-evening EU-friendly slot.

Also attaching a quick timezone matrix to make conversions easier. Will send calendar invite once we agree.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
attachments: cross-region-timezone-matrix.xlsx
From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-region demo — options for next week

Marissa —

Thanks for the options. Our engineering leads on the West Coast prefer earlier in the day; can we do Wed, Mar 10 at 8:00 AM PT? That gives us a clean start-of-day slot. Weʼll have: myself (lead PM), Sara Lin (eng), and Tom Briggs (security).

If that ends up being painful for the EU folks we can shift, but 8:00 AM PT is best for our team.

—John
John Doe
Senior PM, Platform — Acme Corp
john.doe@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, Acme Corp Scheduling <scheduling@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Cross-region demo — options for next week

Folks — forwarding Johnʼs preference: Wed, Mar 10 at 8:00 AM PT (Johnʼs team: PM + eng + security).

Reminder: US DST starts Sun, Mar 8. Because the US moves earlier than EU, the PT->CET offset will be one hour smaller for the week(s) following Mar 8 until Europe moves on Mar 29. Concretely: Wed, Mar 10 at 8:00 AM PT will be 11:00 AM ET but 16:00 CET (not 17:00 CET) because of the DST shift. Can you confirm EU coverage for 16:00 CET on Mar 10?

If EU coverage at 16:00 is tight we can offer a late slot (Thu 02:30 CET next day) but thatʼs on the late side. Otherwise, Sean — can you/one of our leads take the 16:00 CET slot? Jonas — would you be the presenter for EU technical Q&A?

Iʼm attaching the timezone matrix again and will draft the calendar invite once you confirm whoʼs presenting.

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi all —

Confirmed, I can present on Wed, Mar 10. 16:00 CET works for me (I can stay late). Sean — if you can join that window thatʼd be ideal for covering escalation/path-to-prod questions.

Marissa — once you send the invite please include a short agenda: 1) 10–15 min overview, 2) 20–25 min walkthrough with sample prompt sets, 3) 10 min Q&A and next steps. Also add the note about the DST quirk in the invite description so ACME attendees donʼt get surprised.

Thanks —

Best,
